|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •Kashyyyk Insurgent Leader. The later version [[Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent (V)]] (PC-E1, the current card) is titled •Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent with the same game text. The release-sheet slip on this page prints •Kashyyyk Insurgent Leader; the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image print •Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent (see [[Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent (V)]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): titled “•Kashyyyk Insurgent Leader” (lore “Wookiee. “GHRRRRAARRRRHG!””) on the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet, slip 03: “"Occupy" on Forest Depths is treated as "control." Non-unique Wookiees here are Heroic. Once per game, when deployed, may 'roar' to take one card into hand from Used Pile (reshuffle) and/or stack a Wookiee from hand on Grrrghrrrgh!.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 15, 2010"; PDF made 23 December 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-Tarfful_Wookiee_Insurgent.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list still showed the card under this title from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013.<ref name="cl-1272_18-old">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive; the same in the VMasterType list): “Kashyyyk Insurgent Leader”</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent (V)]]): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “Kashyyyk Insurgent Leader ---> Tarfful”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The PC website card list shows the new title by 14 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1272_18-new">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314031820/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-03-14] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130516000419/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-05-16] (Internet Archive): “Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent” (these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 15) prints the card as “•Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent” (lore “Leader.”)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “"Occupy" on Forest Depths is treated as "control." Non-unique Wookiees here are Heroic. Once per game, when deployed, may 'roar' to take one card into hand from Used Pile (reshuffle) and/or stack a Wookiee from hand on Grrrghrrrgh!.” The game text did not change. The PC website card list (2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11, titled “Kashyyyk Insurgent Leader”) has “Occupy on Forest Depths is treated as 'control.'” and “from Used Pile reshuffle, and/or” (punctuation only, held for a ruling). The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1272-18-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-tarffulwookieeinsurgent-pre.gif]]) print it.
